about: Reconstructed story dungeon encounters (re/dungeon-reconstruction-plan.md, accepted 2026-10-11). The original server's encounter scripts and its 2000xxxx monster templates are not in the client. Each spawn below places a monster the client knows (NPCConfig) at an authored scene-editor point; the reason and the confidence of every decision are recorded. Waves follow the dungeon's quest stages; "quest" is the DungeonQuestConfig _iQuestID a wave plays (the client tracker shows it). Switch: Ro3Emu:ReconstructedDungeons. Never mixed into client data.

monsterAttacks.about: A template without a normal attack of its own borrows the normal attack of the named monster. None does now: the story bosses swing their own MainStory_*NormalAttack rows and the airship crew the rows their NPCConfig lists (MonsterService.NormalAttack, BossNormalAttacks).

soloTuning.about: Story bosses were fought with allied NPC companions in the original; those are not reproduced. Each is scaled (basis points of HP and of attack) so a Swordman at the boss level, every stat point spent STR:VIT 2:1, no equipment, normal attacks only, kills it in about 90 s and would fall to it in about 1.4 times that (DungeonTests.EveryStoryBossIsASoloFightAtItsLevel). Inferred, not original data.
